shortDescription: According to ChainCatcher citing Liquid247.xyz, Hyperliquid address 0x1f250d...f925 reduced its BTC short position by 1,250 BTC, with a notional value of $75.18 million. At publication, BTC was trading at $60,147, and the address still held a 250 BTC short position valued at $15.04 million.
